geometry_measurements.method: Median grayscale profiles across25 native pixels at three positions along each edge; three separated line peaks; contrast-weighted centroids within4pixels and fitted edge axes. Coordinates document the assembled source; no artwork is warped or regenerated.

source_preservation: Native pages and dimensional source contexts retained. No inferred repair, synthetic isolated terminal, new icon or outline replacement.
